item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's mother melts some wax in a steel spoon to seal the wick of a homemade diya. Later, Meena melts some chocolate to pour over fruit. To decide whether each change is reversible, Meena asks one question about each change.

Which question helps her decide, and which change is reversible?

options.A: Ask: does the substance look different now? Both melting the wax and melting the chocolate are reversible.
options.B: Ask: can the original substance be brought back in its starting form? Both melted wax and melted chocolate can solidify back, so both changes are reversible.
options.C: Ask: can the original substance be brought back in its starting form? Melting the wax is reversible, but once something has changed it can never go back, so the chocolate is not reversible.
options.D: Ask: does the change happen quickly? Melting wax is slow so it is reversible; melting chocolate is quick so it is not reversible.
